bundle.shortDescription: Material 3 desktop GUI for the Codex CLI
bundle.longDescription: Codex Studio is a Windows desktop front end for the OpenAI Codex CLI. Every action is a real `codex` invocation — the GUI composes the flags, streams the output and never reimplements the agent.
